Women were forbidden to mourn beyond three days, except four months and ten days for a husband without kohl, perfume or coloured clothes, save light perfume after menses.
Uthman would not remove a widows' verse said to be abrogated; the widow's four months and ten days, her year's bequest of residence, and a pregnant widow's term are explained.
Uthman told Ibn az-Zubair he would not move anything of the Quran from its place, keeping the widows' verse said to be abrogated.
A woman mourns her husband four months and ten days and anyone else three days at most, without kohl, perfume or dyed clothes; verse 2:240 on widows' residence is explained.
One who looks after and works for a widow and a poor person is like a fighter in Allah's Cause, or one who fasts by day and prays all night.
